meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve the Retreat Meeting Minutes of January 31, 2023
votes.description: The Council voted to approve the official retreat meeting minutes from January 31, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Downtown Building Height and Street Activation Text Amendment and defer action to a future Council Meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a zoning text amendment affecting building heights in the Downtown Plan area and deferred a final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 6 for Fiscal Year 2022-23 and defer the item to a future Council Meeting for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the sixth budget amendment for FY2022-23, which includes funding for various projects such as the Seven Canyons Fountain and ARPA allocations, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality Program grant application and defer the item to the Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a federal grant application for traffic signal synchronization at approximately 31 intersections and referred it to the Consent Agenda for approval.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 19 of 2023 – Text Amendment for Homeless Resource Centers (HRCs) and Shelters, with additional legislative intents and a legislative action initiation
votes.description: The Council adopted a zoning text amendment establishing a process for approving future Homeless Resource Centers, including an HRC Overlay District and updated standards, along with legislative intents regarding performance metrics and a legislative action to research CEPTED standards for homeless-service-related uses.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 20 of 2023 – Zoning Map Amendment for 792 West 900 South and 875 South 800 West, with a restrictive covenant limiting building height to 35 feet
votes.description: The Council approved rezoning two properties from M-1 (Light Manufacturing) to R-MU (Residential/Mixed Use) to allow development of small multi-family dwellings, subject to a recorded restrictive covenant capping building height at 35 feet.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2023 – Election services interlocal cooperation agreement between Salt Lake City and Salt Lake County for the 2023 municipal general election
votes.description: The Council approved an interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County to provide ranked-choice voting election services for the November 7, 2023 general election.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 12 of 2023 – Naming the Salt Lake International Airport Greeting Room the Senator Garn Greeting Room
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution supporting the Mayor's naming of the airport greeting room after former Salt Lake City Mayor and U.S. Senator Jake Garn.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 13 of 2023 – Extension of the local emergency declaration relating to flooding through June 15, 2023
votes.description: The Council extended the Mayor's April 12, 2023 local emergency proclamation regarding spring runoff flooding until June 15, 2023, unless earlier terminated or further extended.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 14 of 2023 – Tentative budget for Salt Lake City, Utah, including the tentative budget of the Library Fund, for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: The Council approved the tentative FY2023-24 budget for Salt Lake City and the Library Fund, initiating the formal budget review process ahead of final adoption.

The Council approved a consent agenda including grant holding account items (Batch No. 9), board appointments to the Sister Cities Board and reappointments to the Arts Council, UPACA, and Mosquito Abatement Board.

votes.motion: Approve the LBA meeting minutes of May 18, 2021; June 1, 2021; June 15, 2021; August 17, 2021; May 3, 2022; May 17, 2022; June 7, 2022; and June 14, 2022
votes.description: The Local Building Authority Board approved several previously unconfirmed meeting minutes spanning 2021 and 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 1 of 2023 – Tentative budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: The LBA Board approved the tentative FY2023-24 Capital Projects Fund budget, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Local Building Authority meeting and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency Board of Directors
votes.description: The LBA Board voted to formally adjourn the LBA session and transition to the Redevelopment Agency Board meeting.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 09 of 2023 – Tentative budget for the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: The RDA Board approved the tentative FY2023-24 budget for the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City, initiating the formal budget review process.
